description.mn: Acqua di Parma Yuzu: Unisex цитрус үнэр (EDP). Эхний ноот: бергамот, сычуань чинжүү, юзу; зүрхний ноот: мимоза, бадамлянхуа, нил цэцгийн навч, жасмин; суурь ноот: заар, чихэр өвс, зандан мод.
description.en: Yuzu Eau de Parfum by Acqua di Parma is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Yuzu Eau de Parfum was launched in 2019. Top notes are calabrian bergamot, sichuan pepper and yuzu; middle notes are mimosa, lotus, violet leaf and jasmine; base notes are musk, licorice and sandalwood.
